verdict.rationale: Statsig's official MCP server lets AI clients like Claude Code and Cursor explore experiments and access Statsig data. The versioned Console API, which has a public OpenAPI spec, offers programmatic CRUD over console actions, so experiment configurations are clearly readable by an agent. Programmatic retrieval of experiment results is only implied: lifts with confidence intervals are documented as console reports, not as an API or MCP output. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a results/scorecard endpoint or MCP tool that returns metric lifts and significance, documented ship/rollback decision support for agents, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent summarizing results.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
reports metric lifts with confidence intervals
